verdict.rationale: CoreWeave docs confirm S3-compatible Object Storage for moving training data, checkpoints, and model weights directly to GPU compute, and the Terraform provider can manage AI Object Storage buckets/policies as code (coreweave-docs-10, coreweave-docs-6). Community evidence also shows a real-world multi-exabyte storage partnership (Backblaze) suggesting external data movement capability (coreweave-comm-10). However, there is no documented dedicated transfer tool (e.g., CLI sync utility, rclone-style guide) or explicit cloud-storage sync feature beyond the S3-compatible API. Missing for 10: explicit transfer/sync tooling documentation, benchmarks or independent verification of transfer throughput, and details on cross-cloud sync workflows.
